project.name: jawelte (datasource-module aggregator)
project.description: @DataSourceDefinition support for jawelte. datasource-module/api ships the DataSourceFactory port (annotation to javax.sql.DataSource); datasource-module/impl ships the CDI extension that discovers @DataSourceDefinition / @DataSourceDefinitions on the test class and on bean classes, the DataSourceLifecycleAdapter (TestModuleLifecyclePort at @Priority(150), between scope-module at 100 and jpa-module at 200), the reflective default factory, JNDI binding through core/api's JndiContextProvider port, and synthetic @Named DataSource beans for injection. Opt-in like every other module: without the impl jar on the classpath nothing observes the annotations and behaviour is unchanged. Depends on neither jpa-module nor jta-module — a DataSource is a JDBC concern and is useful without either.
